items.raw_excerpt: The Algarve will once again celebrate American automotive culture this weekend as Americancars Algarve returns to Faro for its 13th edition, bringing together more than 150 American vehicles for three days of classic cars, live music and family entertainment.
items.summary_en: The Algarve celebrates American car culture this weekend. Americancars Algarve returns to Faro with over 150 American vehicles. It offers three days of classic cars, live music and family fun.

items.raw_excerpt: Ngày 30-7, Công an và Công đoàn phường Ngũ Hành Sơn phối hợp tổ chức ký kết quy chế phối hợp và ra mắt mô hình “Nghiệp đoàn Làng đá mỹ nghệ Non Nước 3 không về phòng, chống ma túy” nhằm phát huy vai trò của đoàn viên công đoàn và người lao động Làng nghề đá mỹ nghệ Non Nước trong công tác phòng, chống tội phạm và tệ nạn xã hội ở cơ sở.
items.summary_en: The police and the ward labor union in Da Nang launched a new anti-drug program. It is called the 'Three No' union model for the Non Nuoc stone carving village. Workers of the craft village will help prevent crime and social problems.

items.raw_excerpt: Originally a term from the world of ballroom dancing, this is now something that you will want to avoid while in France.
items.summary_en: Chasse-croise comes from ballroom dancing. In France it now means the summer holiday traffic rush. Roads fill with cars going in opposite directions, so drivers should avoid it.
items.summary_ko: 샤세크루아제는 원래 무도회 춤에서 온 표현입니다. 프랑스에서는 여름휴가철 차량이 양방향으로 몰리는 교통 혼잡을 뜻합니다. 운전자는 이 시기를 피하는 것이 좋습니다.
items.title_en: French Word of the Day: Chasse-croise
items.title_original: French Expression of the Day: Chassé-croisé

items.raw_excerpt: The Hobart city council has voted to refer a matter concerning its deputy lord mayor and the taking home of snacks to Tasmania Police and the director of local government.
items.summary_en: The Hobart city council voted to send a matter to Tasmania Police and the director of local government. The matter is about the deputy lord mayor and snacks taken home. People in Hobart are watching this small and unusual case closely.

items.raw_excerpt: On 8 August, the 2026 Sovereign Portuguese Student Art Prize opens in Estremoz, offering visitors the perfect opportunity to combine art, history, food and wine in one of the Alentejo's most beautiful historic towns.
items.summary_en: On 8 August, the Sovereign Portuguese Student Art Prize opens in Estremoz. Visitors can enjoy art, history, food and wine in one of the Alentejo's most beautiful historic towns.

items.title_en: Student Art Prize Opens in the Historic Town of Estremoz
items.title_original: Art, History and Wine: A Day Out in Estremoz

items.raw_excerpt: A woman in Twente was enjoying the sunshine in her garden on Wednesday when she came face to face with a tarantula the size of a dinner plate. Dierenambulance Enschede posted photos of the poisonous spider on social media after they were called to the town of Oldenzaal to retrieve the arachnid. The woman spotted the creature in her yard and informed the regional animal ambulance, who were able to capture it by placing a container over the creature and...
items.summary_en: A woman in the town of Oldenzaal found a tarantula as big as a dinner plate in her garden. The regional animal ambulance was called and caught the spider by placing a container over it. Photos of the poisonous spider were shared on social media.
items.summary_ko: 트벤테 지역의 한 여성이 정원에서 접시만 한 크기의 타란툴라를 발견했다. 지역 동물구급대가 올덴잘 마을로 출동해 용기로 거미를 덮어 잡았다. 독이 있는 이 거미의 사진이 사회관계망에 올라왔다.
items.title_en: Woman finds dinner-plate-sized tarantula in her garden

items.raw_excerpt: The first day of the nation's biggest Indigenous gathering was political, but the must-see guest was not a member of parliament.
items.summary_en: Bluey, the famous kids' TV character, was the most popular guest at the Garma Festival. The event is Australia's biggest Indigenous gathering. Politics got attention too, but Bluey drew the crowd.

items.raw_excerpt: The Women's Natural Building Collective has its roots in the Alentejo and is run by a core group of experienced natural builders: Lola Byron, Adi Urbach and Melodie Correia.
items.summary_en: In the Alentejo, a women's group teaches natural building. The Women's Natural Building Collective was started there. It is run by experienced builders Lola Byron, Adi Urbach and Melodie Correia.

items.raw_excerpt: The Government has established the National Day of the Vine and Wine, to be celebrated annually on 31 July, recognising wine as a cornerstone of the Portuguese table with social, economic, cultural, religious, environmental, and landscape dimensions.
items.summary_en: Portugal's government has set July 31 as the National Day of the Vine and Wine. The day will be celebrated every year. Wine is seen as a key part of Portuguese life and culture.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 정부가 매년 7월 31일을 포도나무와 와인의 날로 정했습니다. 이 날은 해마다 기념될 예정입니다. 포르투갈에서는 와인이 사회와 경제, 문화, 종교 등 삶 곳곳에 자리 잡은 핵심 요소로 여겨집니다.
items.title_en: Portugal creates a national day for wine
items.title_original: Portugal establishes National Vine and Wine Day, to be celebrated on 31 July
